paragraphs.text: Pontotoc finished 11th in the Class 5A boys state golf championship, totaling 733 strokes at Tunica National Golf Course. The MHSAA host list dates the meet to Oct. 19–20; the association posted the completed results Oct. 22.
Elijah Farris led the Warriors with rounds of 79 and 89 for a 168 total, tying for 16th individually. Reed Barbles tied for 41st at 180 after rounds of 79 and 101.

The other listed Pontotoc totals were Barrett Lewis at 193, Sheff White at 194, Bowen Kidd at 195 and Thomas Jefcoat at 198. The complete individual standings are available in the official results linked below.
Pontotoc’s team rounds were 345 and 388. New Hope won the championship with 644 strokes, followed by Sumrall at 662 and Caledonia at 665.
